name: aranis-mcp
description: Connect Codex to the Aranis remote MCP server: third-party risk, inventory, risk register, privacy, continuity, documents, Trust Center and BI.

interface.shortDescription: Your Aranis organization in Codex: read it, and change it with your confirmation.
interface.longDescription: Works with your Aranis organization from Codex: vendors and their risk, control gaps and action plans, the asset and process inventory, the risk register, privacy (processing activities, LIA, RIPD, TIA, DIA), business impact analysis and continuity, documents, the Trust Center and BI. Sign-in happens through Aranis with OAuth, with no key to paste, and you choose which organization the access applies to. Every change is shown to you first and only happens after you confirm; which changes are available depends on your organization's plan and your role.
defaultPrompt: Quais fornecedores da minha organização estão sem avaliação concluída?
Quais processos críticos ainda não têm estratégia de recuperação?
Monte um painel de BI com os riscos abertos por categoria.
